scope: Bounded black-earth ceiling cross-sections and release regressions for accumulated game work; not a full campaign certification.

notes: Opaque backing is confined to the existing collision profile, with chipped inset edges and the same landing margins.
Floor geological strata are reversed for the ceiling underside, with separately oriented side samples blended at corners.
The dark interior never extends above the support into an upper playable route.
Native collision profiles and measured visual/jump headroom remain unchanged.
Support removal and late obstacles retire the whole vault; returning cannot regrow it over the player.

tests.coverage: 39 rooms, 22 live vaults, 28 mass checks including two scaled lifecycle fixtures
110 actual-controller jump/walk checks under unchanged ceiling collisions
72 full-body contacts across seven bosses and rematch
50 lifecycle/deferred-hit cases plus piercing, spawn, pause disposal
gold, XP and iron settling, animation and no-jump collection
105 contours in 18 rooms, 898 slope plants, 36 controller walks, six profiles

native_previews.notes: Actual player physics settles on both original floors; camera offsets are preview-only. Final shader joins and both textured side edges reviewed after two visual iterations.

editor_import.notes: Asset import/class registration completed. Sandbox denied saving global editor settings outside workspace; project import itself succeeded.

limitations: Focused regression selection, not the entire 307-test suite or a full normal-health playthrough.
Windows root-certificate warning in tool runs; native renderer also reports sandbox shader-cache write denials, not shader compile failures.
No device/FPS benchmark, no new raster generation, and no claim that all remaining game artwork is production-complete.
Run folders are local ignored artifacts; source tests, this report and native previews are versioned.
